decisions.reason: Removing a literal newline artifact from the title does not change whether chapter images are included or how they are placed.
The title-formatting correction does not change the requested editorial assessment of AI-generated chapter images.
The source only resolves a title-page formatting artifact and does not alter the manuscript-polish objectives or specified passage edits.
Correcting a literal newline artifact in the title does not change the requested paperback publishing guidance.
The client clarifies that the title artifact was not author-added, but this does not change the requirement to integrate the client-reviewed manuscript and highlighted author revisions.
